answer.thought: The day has been a long, tiring march. I have walked thirteen kilometres and the body, that stubborn particularity, now demands rest. I shall sit on the veranda and let the cool air settle the dust in my head before I attempt to write to Dr. Lindner tomorrow. The file is gone for fifteen days, and the evening is quiet.
